Package model

Class Zoo

java.lang.Object
model.Zoo
public class Zoo extends Object
Description: Represents the main zoo manager, handling collections of habitats, animals, and employees.

      public Zoo(String name, String city, String addres, int legalRepresentativeCode, String legalRepresentativeName, double budget)
      Description: Constructs a new Zoo object with its general information, initializes the veterinary clinic habitat, and sets up the habitats and employees collections.

      name - Name of the zoo.
      city - City where the zoo is located.

    • addHabitat

      public boolean addHabitat(String HabitatId, String name, int environment, double temperature, double area, int maxCapacity, double budget, int state)
      Description: Adds a new habitat to the zoo's collection after calculating its environment type.
      Parameters:
      HabitatId - Unique identifier code for the habitat.
      name - Name of the habitat.
      environment - Integer representing the environment type option.
      temperature - Temperature of the habitat.
      area - Area size of the habitat.
      maxCapacity - Maximum animal capacity of the habitat.
      budget - Monthly budget allocated for the habitat.
      state - Operational state of the habitat.
      Returns:
      True if the habitat was successfully added, false otherwise. Precondition: The habitats list must be initialized. Habitat should not already exist in the list. Postcondition: A new Habitat object is created and added to the zoo's habitats collection.

    • assignEmployeeToHabitat

      public boolean assignEmployeeToHabitat(String habitatId, String employeeID)
      Description: Assigns an employee to a specified habitat based on their IDs.
      Parameters:
      habitatId - Identifier of the target habitat.
      employeeID - Identifier of the target employee.
      Returns:
      True if the employee was successfully assigned, false otherwise. Precondition: Both target habitat and employee must exist in the zoo system. Postcondition: The employee is added to the habitat's assigned personnel list if valid.

    • transferAnimal

      public boolean transferAnimal(String AnimalId, String HabitatId)
      Description: Transfers an animal from its current habitat to a new destination habitat.
      Parameters:
      AnimalId - Identifier code of the animal to transfer.
      HabitatId - Identifier code of the destination habitat.
      Returns:
      True if the transfer is successful, false otherwise. Precondition: The destination habitat must exist and the animal must be located in an existing habitat. Postcondition: The animal is added to the target habitat and removed from its source habitat.

    • addCleaningActivity

      public boolean addCleaningActivity(String habitatId, String employeeId, LocalDate schedulingDate, String description, String usedProducts) throws exceptions.ZooCareBusinessException
      Adds a cleaning activity to the zoo. This method ensures that the habitat and employee exist and are valid for the activity. It also validates that the employee is active and authorized to perform the activity.
      Parameters:
      habitatId - The unique identifier of the habitat where the activity will take place.
      employeeId - The unique identifier of the employee responsible for the activity.
      schedulingDate - The date when the activity is scheduled.
      description - A description of the cleaning activity.
      usedProducts - A string containing the products used in the cleaning activity, separated by a hyphen ("-").
      Returns:
      true if the cleaning activity was successfully added, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      exceptions.ZooCareBusinessException - If any of the following conditions occur:
      • The habitat does not exist (HABITAT_NOT_FOUND).
      • The employee does not exist (EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND).
      • The employee is not active (EMPLOYEE_NOT_ACTIVE).
      • The employee is not authorized to perform the activity (EMPLOYEE_NOT_AUTHORIZED).

    • addEnrichmentActivity

      public boolean addEnrichmentActivity(String habitatId, String employeeId, LocalDate schedulingDate, String description, int durationInDays, String usedProducts) throws exceptions.ZooCareBusinessException
      Adds an enrichment activity to the zoo. This method ensures that the habitat and employee exist and are valid for the activity. It also validates that the employee is active and authorized to perform the activity.
      Parameters:
      habitatId - The unique identifier of the habitat where the activity will take place.
      employeeId - The unique identifier of the employee responsible for the activity.
      schedulingDate - The date when the activity is scheduled.
      description - A description of the enrichment activity.
      durationInDays - The duration of the enrichment activity in days.
      usedProducts - A string containing the products used in the enrichment activity, separated by a hyphen ("-").
      Returns:
      true if the enrichment activity was successfully added, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      exceptions.ZooCareBusinessException - If any of the following conditions occur:
      • The habitat does not exist (HABITAT_NOT_FOUND).
      • The employee does not exist (EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND).
      • The employee is not active (EMPLOYEE_NOT_ACTIVE).
      • The employee is not authorized to perform the activity (EMPLOYEE_NOT_AUTHORIZED).

    • getEnrichmentDescriptionInMonth

      public String getEnrichmentDescriptionInMonth(LocalDate date)
      Retrieves a concatenated string of descriptions for all enrichment activities that occurred in the same month and year as the specified date. Preconditions: - The `date` parameter must not be null. - The `myActivities` list must not be null and should contain valid `Activity` objects.
      Parameters:
      date - The LocalDate object representing the month and year to filter the enrichment activities by.
      Returns:
      A string containing the descriptions of all enrichment activities that match the specified month and year. If no activities match, an empty string is returned.

    • setUsedProductsInCleaningActivity

      public boolean setUsedProductsInCleaningActivity(String newProducts, String idActivity)
      Updates the list of products used in a cleaning activity identified by the given ID. Preconditions: - The `newProducts` parameter must not be null or empty. - The `idActivity` parameter must not be null or empty. - The `myActivities` list must not be null and should contain valid `Activity` objects. Postconditions: - If a cleaning activity with the specified ID exists, its list of products will be updated with the new products provided.
      Parameters:
      newProducts - A string containing the new products to be set, separated by hyphens ("-").
      idActivity - The ID of the cleaning activity to update.
      Returns:
      true if the cleaning activity with the specified ID was found and updated; false otherwise.

      Counts the number of feeding activities that occurred in a specific habitat during the specified month and year.       Parameters:
      habitatId - The ID of the habitat to filter the feeding activities by.
      date - The LocalDate object representing the month and year to filter the feeding activities by.
      Returns:
      The number of feeding activities that match the specified habitat ID and date.

      date - The LocalDate object representing the year to filter the activities by.
